metadata.title: Rain Sounds for Sleep Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly out-of-focus photograph of a surface covered in various sizes of water droplets, creating a textured and reflective appearance. The background is a blurred, dark teal-blue, suggesting depth and a soft light source. White text is centrally placed, with a smaller, stylized signature in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Water droplets create a textured overlay on a blurred background.
The main text is prominent and centered, contrasting with the busy background.
The background's soft focus emphasizes the foreground water droplets.
The signature text is small and subtly placed, distinct from the main title.
coreInvariants: Dominant blue-green color palette with white text.
Textured surface of water droplets covering the majority of the image.
Soft, out-of-focus background behind the water droplets.
Clear contrast between the white text and the dark background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The water droplets are the primary visual subject, filling almost the entire frame. The main text is centrally located, occupying approximately 25-30% of the image width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dense pattern of water droplets serves as the visual anchor, providing texture and depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn initially to the central white text, then explores the intricate details and varying sizes of the water droplets across the image. The subtle bokeh in the background provides a soft, calming visual flow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred, darker areas between and behind the water droplets function as negative space, allowing the droplets and text to stand out. The overall density of droplets minimizes large areas of true negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark teal-blue (e.g., #214C5B) forms the dominant background, conveying a cool, calming, and aquatic atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (e.g., #FFFFFF) is used for the main text, providing high contrast and readability against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lighter blues and greens within the water droplets (e.g., #50808F, #A0D0D8) act as subtle accents, adding dimension and realism to the water texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is moderately saturated and dark in value, while the water droplets show a range of values from dark to very light, with highlights creating a sense of wetness and reflection. The text is pure white, maximizing value contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Limit the palette primarily to blues, greens, and white.
Avoid warm or highly saturated colors that would disrupt the calm mood.

letterConstructionRules: Maintain consistent stroke width for the main body of letters.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrastive pairing of a clean, legible sans-serif for the main title with an elegant, flowing script for the signature, creating a balance between clarity and artistic flair.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadow for text legibility and depth.

preserve: High legibility for the main title.
Soft, natural feel for the background.
Clear contrast between text and background.
Elegant, flowing style for the secondary text.

Fonts with very high stroke contrast for the main title.
Overly decorative or unreadable script fonts for the secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: These sans-serif fonts offer good readability, moderate x-height, and a clean, friendly aesthetic similar to the main title.
These have slightly more rounded characteristics and a humanist touch, which would align with the soft feel of the image.
These script fonts provide a flowing, elegant, and connected style suitable for the signature.
These offer a more casual but still legible script style, which could also work for the signature depending on the desired tone.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up, slightly out-of-focus image of a window or surface covered in various sizes of clear water droplets. The background behind the droplets should be a blurred, dark teal-blue, suggesting a soft, diffused light source. Ensure a good range of highlights and shadows within the droplets to convey depth and wetness.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title text 'Rain Sounds For Sleep' in white, using a clean, semi-bold sans-serif font, centered horizontally and slightly above the vertical midpoint. Apply a subtle, soft dark gray drop shadow to the text. In the bottom right corner, overlay the signature text 'Silent Chills' in white, using an elegant, flowing script font, also with a subtle dark gray drop shadow. Ensure both texts are legible against the water droplet background.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text clearly legible against the background?
Do the water droplets appear realistic and varied in size?
Is the background color a calming dark teal-blue?
Is the signature text distinct and elegant?
Are the shadows subtle and not distracting?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of blue-green for the background.
Density and size distribution of water droplets.
Intensity and offset of the text drop shadows.
Specific sans-serif and script font choices (within recommended categories).
Vertical position of the main title.

mustAchieve: A sense of calm and tranquility.
High readability of the main title.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the overall mood is serene and conducive to relaxation.
Check for any artifacts or unnatural patterns in the water droplets.
Ensure text contrast is sufficient for small screen readability.
Confirm that the signature text is aesthetically pleasing and not too small.
Assess if the image feels balanced and harmonious.
recipe.reuseFormula: Generate a textured background of water droplets on a blurred, dark teal-blue surface. Overlay a prominent, centered, white sans-serif title with a soft drop shadow. Add a smaller, white script signature with a soft drop shadow in the bottom right.
